def transform(grid):
    """Tile four rotations: original, clockwise, counterclockwise, 180 degrees."""
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    half = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    return ([grid[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] +
            [counterclockwise[r] + half[r] for r in range(n)])
